На стихию: Голос сонма (элита, маг ДД), Хозяин (клановый босс, маг ДД), щит (танк) и лекарь — одни на оба этажа, два контролёра этажа элиты, два бойца этажа босса (физ ДД силы и ловкости). Все — саганы: сила, заметившая себя в камне. Кадр, стиль и свет — как у врагов биома 3 (jobs/biome-03-library-v2.json) по «Глубокому промту персонажа» (art/style/style.md). Свет — цвет своей стихии снизу. Выгрузка — design/ui/assets/art/clan/<стихия>-<роль>.jpg, строки ui-art.json — по таблице в docs/content/клан.md.
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Epic, dramatic character art: a powerful pose, a low camera, strong theatrical light from below. Light tells the story: a few strong sources glowing from within — the living element itself and cracks and crystals in the dark rock below — throw colored light upward; the light comes from below. Colored light against near-black shadow. Dust motes, sparks, droplets or grains float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms; the face, the hands and the weapon get the most detail. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime, no cartoon.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no glyphs, no runes that look like letters, no real-world scripts, no carvings that look like writing or numerals, no occult symbols, no pentagrams, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture. No gore, no blood, no skulls, no horror grotesque. No nudity, no cleavage, no sexualized forms. No hood on anyone. Only one figure in the foreground; it has exactly two arms and two hands. Not a mannequin, not a crash-test dummy, not a marionette on strings, not a statue on display, not a person in a costume: no stiff, passive, awkward or doll-like pose, no dead or empty eyes.

clan.frame: Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Enemy card portrait, 4:5. The card is shown small on the battle field (about 74 px wide) and large in the bestiary, so the enemy must read as one bold, simple, well-lit silhouette with a clear pose against a darker background. Framing: a close, heroic half-length portrait, cropped like a bust at the waist. The camera is close, a little below the figure's chest, and looks slightly up, so the enemy towers over the viewer and fills most of the frame. We see only the head, the shoulders, the chest, the arms and the hands; the bottom edge of the picture cuts through the waist or the belt. Hips, legs, knees and feet are never visible — whatever is below the waist is simply out of the picture. The head sits in the upper third with a little space above it. The body is turned in three-quarter view toward the LEFT side of the picture, where its enemies stand; its weapon, its spell or the thing it is named after is thrust toward the left, in front of the body, and reads clearly. Pathos: it is a worthy and dangerous enemy — powerful, proud, alive and caught at the peak of an action, a foe that is frightening and honourable to defeat. Its character shows in its face, its gaze and its posture; its story shows in the details of its body. World: these are sagans — thinking energy, the power of an element that has noticed itself in stone and taken a body. A sagan's body is made of its living element — water, fire, rock, wind, light, shadow or sand — and of the thing it woke in, as the description says; it is not a living human, not an animal and not a machine. Its body is always decently covered — by a robe, a gown, armor or plates of its own element, or by the garment the description names; no nudity, no bare breasts. It has the shape of a strong figure with a head, a torso and exactly two arms, shaped simply and powerfully like a sculpture of its element, and a strong individual face with alive, intent eyes that glow in the color of its element. Seven hosts of sagans, one for each element, rise from the depths under the world toward the light of a great crystal. Light, the same for the whole set: the light comes from below, in the color of the figure's element, from the element itself and from glowing cracks and crystals in the dark rock below; a crisp rim light of the same color on its edges; everything else sinks into near-black shadow. Background: its host's own place in the depths, darker and softer than the figure, with depth. All fifty-six portraits share the same framing, painting style and lighting; only the element, its color and the figure tell them apart.
